title: This water freezes in one second 🧊
caption:
One tap and the whole bottle turns to ice 🧊
Save this for a hot day and try it 👇
first_comment: Did it work for you? Tell us how long you froze it 👇
sources: Supercooling: pure water can stay liquid below 0 °C without nucleation sites; a shock or an ice crystal starts freezing (US Geological Survey Water Science School; Royal Society of Chemistry, 'supercooled water')
Typical home method: purified bottled water, about 2-2.5 hours in a home freezer (time varies by freezer)
